title: ILPU: Iterative Laplace-Based Phase Unwrapping via Bi-Level Optimization
summary: Phase unwrapping is an essential preprocessing step for phase-based MRI applications, including susceptibility mapping, field mapping, thermometry, and MR elastography. We present Iterative Laplace-Based Phase Unwrapping (ILPU), a bi-level optimization algorithm. In this method, a lower-level solver recovers a continuous phase increment from an incremental Poisson equation using the discrete cosine transform (DCT), while an upper-level solver refines an integer offset map through quality-guided spatial regularization and a restricted local search.
